Upper Text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Dark Dragon]/[Evil Dragon] trait: Cost 4

[On Play] [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] Trash 2 cards in your hand and delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon. Then, if you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [Evil], [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon would leave the battle area, if you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, trash your opponent's top security card.
